name: Focus mode
author: JARVIS
description: Pomodoro-style focus: closes distractions, plays focus music quietly and times 25-minute blocks with short breaks.

skills.name: Focus mode
skills.when_to: I say focus mode, help me focus, or start a pomodoro
skills.body:
1. Ask what I'm working on, unless I already said.
2. List the open windows and offer to close or minimize chat, social media and video apps; only close what I agree to.
3. Play lo-fi or focus music on Spotify and set the volume to 25.
4. Start a 25-minute timer labelled with what I'm working on.
5. Tell me it's started in one short sentence.

skills.name: Break time
skills.when_to: I say break, take a break, or the focus timer ended
skills.body:
1. Pause the music.
2. Start a 5-minute timer labelled break (15 minutes after every fourth focus block).
3. Suggest standing up or getting water, in one sentence.
